name: career-survival-baseline
instruction: Play one complete Career Survival game through the career-emulator-engine MCP tools. At the start, call new_game and then show_employee_handbook once. Then repeat observe and take_action until the run ends. For every decision, use the skills in this submission: career-state-assessment first, then event-decision for story events or quarterly-planning for the quarterly phase. Keep each notes entry short and state the main reason for the choice.
